name: P-38 Lightning
hook: Kelly Johnson's twin-boom fighter. In steep dives it ran into compressibility, years before transonic flight was understood.

remarks.name: Lakshmi N Sankar
remarks.title: Regents Professor & Sikorsky Professor at Georgia Institute of Technology
remarks.text: In transonic flow, shocks move downstream very slowly as they gather strength and the significant time lag between the wing motion and shock motion creates yet another cause for flutter

name: Constellation
hook: The most beautiful airliner ever built has three tails for one reason. A single tail tall enough would not fit in TWA's hangars.

name: P-80 Shooting Star
hook: America's first operational jet fighter was built in 143 days, under a rented circus tent. The tent was not the obstacle. It was the reason.

hook: The F-104's wing was 3.36 percent thick, too thin to carry fuel, sharp enough to cut its ground crews. It was exactly what pilots had asked for.

name: C-130 Hercules
hook: Kelly Johnson told Lockheed's chief engineer the C-130 would destroy the company, then walked out. The slow, unarmed hauler he tried to kill has stayed in production for 70 years, the longest run of any military aircraft, and outlasted every fast jet he championed.

name: U-2
hook: EVERY U-2 LANDING REQUIRES A SPORTS CAR DOING 100+ MPH DOWN THE RUNWAY, WITH ANOTHER PILOT BEHIND THE WHEEL.

name: A-12
hook: The SR-71's shape came from an aircraft called the A-12. The A stands for Archangel. The 12 means eleven designs came first and failed.

name: SR-71 Blackbird
hook: THE SR-71 CRUISED AT MACH 3.2 BUT HAD NO INTERNAL STARTER. TO START IT, THEY USED A CART WITH TWO BUICK V8s MAKING 600+ HP.

remarks.name: Lee Hearn
remarks.title: Sales Support Engineer
remarks.text: It was based on a different philosophy. Costs were far lower than the F15 so they could build more. Its cockpit was also very similar to previous MIGs, something that was derided at the time... until the realisation that any pilots flying older MIGs could be easily reoriented to a new platform. All more in line with Russian military thinking than western militaries. Pilots and machines considered far more expendable

remarks.name: Neil Wilkins
remarks.title: Consulting geologist
remarks.text: Digital is less robust than analogue and tubes are more robust than transistors and microchips.

hook: TO LAND ON A CARRIER, THE F-14 TOMCAT NEEDED A 64-FOOT WINGSPAN. TO CATCH A BOMBER AT MACH 2, IT NEEDED 38. SO GRUMMAN BUILT WINGS THAT MOVE BETWEEN THE TWO IN FLIGHT.

remarks.title: Retired engineer
remarks.text: Just pointing out that the swing-wing was invented by Barnes Wallace, the Brit who also invented the 'bouncing bomb', the 'Tall Boy' and 'Grand Slam' bombs, and the geodesic structure for the Wellington bomber, amongst other things.

hook: THE GAU-8 CANNON GENERATES ~10,000 POUNDS OF RECOIL, MORE THAN A SINGLE A-10 ENGINE'S THRUST. TO KEEP THE FIRING BARREL ON CENTERLINE, FAIRCHILD OFFSET THE NOSE GEAR TO MAKE ROOM FOR THE GUN.

hook: THE AIR FORCE PLANS TO RETIRE THE B-1 AND B-2 IN THE 2030S. THEIR REPLACEMENT FLEW FOR THE FIRST TIME IN NOVEMBER 2023: THE B-21 RAIDER.
